sources.title: Coverage control for mobile sensing networks
sources.reviewed_location: PDF pp.1-5, Sections II-III, equations (1)-(5), Lloyd discussion
sources.supports: Known convex domain and density, Voronoi/Lloyd locational optimization and convergence to CVT critical configurations.
sources.project_inference: CVT is an existing ingredient; this area distance objective is not the frozen original-curve signed service metric.

sources.title: Self-triggered coordination of robotic networks for optimal deployment
sources.version: Automatica 48, 1077-1087; not counted again as its 2011 conference precursor
sources.supports: Guaranteed/dual guaranteed Voronoi sets permit self-triggered information updates with CVT convergence in the stated model.
sources.project_inference: Triggered updates under uncertain information are prior art; convergence does not establish the project's per-frame relative service budget.

sources.title: Distributed area coverage control with imprecise robot localization: Simulation and experimental studies
sources.reviewed_location: Equations (2)-(9), Theorem 1, collision avoidance, simplified control law and Case Study I
sources.supports: Robot-location uncertainty disks, guaranteed sensing regions and AWGV partitions define a guaranteed area objective; the complete law and simplified experimental law have different guarantee scopes.
sources.project_inference: Uncertain robot locations differ from uncertain people generating an endogenous curve.

sources.title: Data-Driven Distributionally Robust Coverage Control by Mobile Robots
sources.version: CDC 2023 final published version, pp.2030-2035 with repository cover
sources.reviewed_location: Sections III-V, Assumption 3.1, equations (3)-(9), especially projection statement following (8)
sources.supports: Haar-wavelet density ambiguity sets incorporate unit mass and density bounds; independent data control probabilistic inclusion of the finite-resolution true-density projection.
sources.project_inference: Mass ambiguity optimization is prior art. Probability/projection guarantees cannot be silently substituted for all bounded-error static worlds.
sources.access_note: research.tudelft.nl PDF open returned 403; same institutional pure.tudelft.nl PDF full text was accessible.

sources.title: Multi-agent coverage control with transient behavior consideration
sources.supports: GP/graph coverage with an approximate oracle has high-probability approximate regret including travel transients; the conclusion explicitly excludes safety from the current theoretical analysis.
sources.project_inference: Accounting for travel is established work; long-horizon regret is different from a per-frame signed original-reference service guarantee.

sources.title: Adaptive Event-Triggered Model Predictive Coverage Control with Average Update-Rate Regulation
sources.version: arXiv:2610.15325v1, submitted 2026-10-11; submitted to ACC 2027, acceptance not established
sources.supports: Bounded trigger values and continuously executable plans yield empirical average update-period guarantees; the inner MPC retains responsibility for feasibility and stability.
sources.project_inference: Average computational update budget differs from insufficient guide count and from pointwise service/safety requirements.
